label: rem:fivefold-crystallographic-obstruction
title: Crystallographic restriction and the weak force as non-lattice 5-fold symmetry
html:
A lattice \Lambda \subset \mathbb{R}^n allows rotational symmetry of order k only if k \in \{1, 2, 3, 4, 6\} (for n = 2, 3). Periodic lattices cannot possess 5-fold rotational symmetry.

See Table 1.

The 5-fold symmetry of Bring's surface uniquely breaks periodicity. It is carried by T_{3,5}, the weak force mediator, which is the only force violating parity and utilizing massive carriers (W^{\pm}, Z^0). The 5-fold symmetry confines the weak force to local, aperiodic interactions, accounting for its weakness.
